regime.instructions: Classify the current market regime for this instrument from the snapshot.

criteria.trending: returns persistent in one direction, flow agrees with returns
criteria.mean_reverting: returns oscillate, flow and book lean against recent moves
criteria.high_vol: realized volatility or spread clearly elevated without crash dynamics
criteria.crisis: disorderly: wide spread, one-sided flow, sharp drop, liquidity vanishing

direction.instructions: Which position, if any, has positive expectancy over the next few bars after paying the spread? Prefer neutral when evidence is mixed. Instrument BTC-PERP. Research thesis (may be wrong): BTC is range-bound near 80-88k into the Oct 27-28 FOMC with a hawkish Fed (Sept hike, Sept CPI 3.7% y/y). Liquidity anchor: the live loop must prove net-of-cost skill here before any altcoin. Thesis is invalidated by: Daily close below 78k; Stablecoin supply falls >2% in 14 days; Funding turns persistently negative alongside rising open interest. Judge only from the snapshot; the thesis is context, not a vote.

toxic_flow.instructions: Proposition: recent aggressive order flow is informed, so a new taker order in the direction of the flow would be adversely selected.
